description:
Maker 3D CAD - the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD.

Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers - the middle ground between
dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD.
Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep),
fillet and chamfer, run booleans, cut threads, and edit any step of the
history later. Sketches export to SVG and DXF at 1:1 mm for laser cutters and
2.5D CNC; it imports STEP, IGES, BREP, STL, SVG and DXF, and exports STEP,
STL, IGES, BREP, glTF, OBJ, 3MF, SVG and DXF. Real B-rep solids on the
OpenCASCADE kernel.
Materializr 1.7.3
A smoothness release: fewer freezes, a friendlier touch interface, and a new windowing layer (SDL3) underneath on every platform.
Added
- Drag and drop: drop a project file on the window to open it in its own tab, or drop STEP, IGES, BREP, SVG, DXF, STL and image files to import them
- Deleting a sketch can be undone
Changed
- Opening a project shows a progress bar instead of locking up the window
- Smoother window resizing
Fixed
- Push/Pull on complex sketches no longer freezes, and a large cut that took over five minutes now takes about a second and gives the correct result
- The first click in a sketch no longer freezes the app
- Extrude refuses a near-zero distance instead of building a degenerate solid, and slow Extrude drags no longer stall
- STL export no longer produces cracked meshes where bodies touch or on extruded splines
- Sketch Offset no longer leaves tiny slivers at near-tangent junctions
- Edges hidden behind a nearer face are no longer picked
